_comment: Sanctioned-pattern catalogue the steward RATIFIES. The semantic gate clears a duplicate cluster only when it matches one of these patterns at quorum; everything else surfaces. With no catalogue the gate surfaces all duplication (the zero-false-clear default). Keep this small and honest — a pattern here means 'this duplication is intentional and must not be consolidated'.

patterns.name: http-verb-wrappers
patterns.description: thin per-verb wrappers (get/post/put/delete/...) that each delegate to a single request(); intentional API symmetry, not fragmentation

patterns.name: versioned-copies
patterns.description: code deliberately duplicated per API/schema version and kept separate on purpose; must not be merged across versions
